# Shorcuts

CTRL + Alt + I = chunk

```{r}
# comment, not executable
1 + 1
```

Alt + - = \<-

```{r}
x  <- 2
y <- 5
x + y
```

CTRL + Shift + M = pipe

```{r}
penguins
```

# Commands

see the dataset

```{r}
penguins
```

## Load a dataset

```{r}
df <- penguins
```

# EDA

## Summary of the dataset

```{r}
summary(penguins)
```

```{r}
summary(penguins$species)
```

```{r}
table(penguins$species, penguins$island)
```

```{r}
mean(penguins$body_mass)
```

```{r}
mean(penguins$body_mass, na.rm = TRUE)
```

## gtsummary

```{r}
penguins |> 
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(by = species, missing = "no")
```

```{r}
View(penguins)
```
